title: The Stepping Stones Chasm Leap
statement:
You are given an integer array nums. You are initially positioned at the array's first index (0), and each element in the array represents your maximum jump length at that position.

Print YES if you can reach the last index, or NO otherwise.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated non-negative integers.

sampleCases.explanation: Jump 1 step from 0 to 1, then 3 steps to the last index.
Always land at index 3 with jump length 0; cannot reach index 4.
